title: Restore & Pamper Retreat at Polperro Farmhouse
summary: 3-day, 2-night wellness retreat at Polperro Farmhouse in Red Hill. Yoga, massage at PHS or Endota, optional juice cleanse, set on a biodynamic vineyard. Booked direct via Polperro or Hut Yoga.
bookingRequired: Yes, contact Polperro or Hut Yoga
priceRange: From approx AUD 1,500–2,000+pp (accommodation + programme; additional services extra)
recurrenceNote: Available on request (not fixed public dates)
suitableFor: Couples; solo travellers; wellness seekers; small groups
accessibilityNotes: Farmhouse accommodation accessible, check with venue
nearbyAttractions: Peninsula Hot Springs; Many Little restaurant (same estate); Flinders Truffles
suggestedItineraryPairing: Full Peninsula wellness immersion: arrive Fri; retreat Sat–Sun; depart Mon with farewell cellar door tasting
editorVerdict: A retreat that takes wellness seriously without the wellness-industrial-complex theatrics.
editorNote:
Three days, two nights at Polperro Farmhouse on the biodynamic vineyard estate in Red Hill. The format pairs yoga (outdoor in summer, studio in winter) with massage at Peninsula Hot Springs or Endota Red Hill, an optional acupressure workshop, and a Peninsula juice cleanse add-on. Run in partnership with Hut Yoga.

Who it's for: couples or solo travellers who want one weekend to genuinely reset, not a buffet of generic spa treatments. From roughly $1,500 to $2,000+ per person depending on inclusions.

The practical move: dates are not fixed, so call Lauren at Polperro on (03) 5989 2871 Wednesday to Sunday, or email info@hutyoga.com.au, and build it around your calendar. Stay Friday night for a soft start, finish Monday with a cellar door tasting at Polperro before you drive home. Book Many Little (same estate) for the farewell lunch.
